svg.title: An exception rises until something can do anything about it
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “An exception rises until something can do anything about it” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A four-frame call stack with main at the top and read_file at the bottom. A red zigzag starts in read_file, passes straight through load_user, which is drawn dashed and annotated as having no except clause, and stops at handle_request where a green box turns it into a 404. A bare except Exception: pass frame is crossed out. On the right, try, except, else and finally are drawn as four bands with finally circled, a with-block whose __exit__ the raising body still passes through, and bars comparing an emitted log call at 3.47 microseconds with a filtered one at 0.068.
svg.text: An exception rises until something can do anything about it
draw it from memory, then compare
